needs.family: Dry adult dog food (high-protein, active/large-breed formula)
needs.description: Complete dry kibble formulated for active, medium-large young dogs (approx. 50 lb). Look for 26–30%+ protein, moderate fat, controlled calcium/phosphorus for an adolescent dog (10 months), sold in 15–30 lb bags. Formulation should support lean muscle, energy for high activity, and be appropriate for a dog transitioning from puppy to adult feeding.
needs.rationale: Thor is a 10-month-old, 50 lb, high-activity Pitbull mix — he needs a balanced, energy-dense kibble designed for active adolescents to meet daily caloric needs and support growth without excess joint stress.

needs.family: High-value small soft training treats (low-calorie, bite-size)
needs.description: Soft, easily breakable training treats (pea- to dime-sized) for frequent positive reinforcement. Select low-calorie, high-palatable options suitable for daily training sessions; use in pouch or reward during walks.
needs.rationale: Thor is a rescue puppy still forming behaviors — frequent positive reinforcement accelerates training. Small soft treats avoid overfeeding and are practical for high-repetition sessions.

needs.family: Biodegradable poop bags (large, strong, roll with dispenser)
needs.description: Heavy-duty large-size biodegradable waste bags on a roll with dispenser that fits a leash or belt. Durable seams for a 50 lb dog and thicker material for outdoor use.
needs.rationale: Daily walks and yard use require reliable waste pickup. Strong bags prevent messes and are essential everyday supplies.

needs.family: Heavy-duty stainless steel water bowl (2–3 quart)
needs.description: Wide-mouth, chew-resistant stainless steel bowl (2–3 qt capacity) with non-slip base. Stainless is durable against strong chewers and easy to sanitize—suitable for indoor and outdoor use in a large yard.
needs.rationale: Thor needs constant access to clean water; stainless steel resists chewing and bacterial growth and is appropriate for a 50 lb active dog in warm weather.

needs.family: Durable chew-resistant leash (6 ft, traffic handle, heavy-duty clasp)
needs.description: 6-foot leash made from reinforced nylon or biothane with welded hardware and a padded traffic handle. Designed for strong pullers and heavy chewing environments; pairing with a harness recommended.
needs.rationale: Thor is a strong, high-activity dog — a secure, heavy-duty leash is essential for safe control on walks and to avoid breakage that could lead to escapes or injury.

needs.family: Rechargeable LED high-visibility collar or wearable safety vest
needs.description: USB-rechargeable LED collar or brightly colored, reflective safety vest sized for a 50 lb dog. Provides 360° visibility at dusk/dawn and can be used during walks or yard time; waterproof/resistant for PNW use.
needs.rationale: Active outdoor dog in hunting season and variable light conditions needs high visibility to prevent accidents and make Thor easy to spot in a large yard. Current excessive-heat and hunting-season context increases risk during outdoor time at dawn/dusk.

needs.family: No-pull front-clip harness (padded, size-adjustable)
needs.description: Front-clip, padded harness sized for a 50 lb dog with multiple adjustment points and reinforced straps. Helps reduce pulling and gives better control than a collar for active, strong dogs.
needs.rationale: Thor is high-energy and likely to pull; a no-pull harness reduces strain on his neck and improves safety/control during training and walks.

needs.family: Crate (durable wire or heavy-duty plastic, appropriate size)
needs.description: A sturdy crate sized so Thor can stand, turn, and lie down comfortably (approx. 36–42" for a 50 lb dog), with a chew-resistant option and removable tray for cleaning. Use with a comfortable crate pad (sold separately).
needs.rationale: Crate provides a safe den for downtime, housetraining reinforcement and a predictable place for a rescue dog to decompress. Not emergency-only—helps behavior and travel prep.
evidence: pet_characteristic: about: Thor is a rescue puppy. Thor is very loving.

needs.family: Cooling mat (thick gel or breathable polyester) for dogs
needs.description: Non-electric cooling mat sized for a medium-large dog, with pressure-activated gel or breathable cooling fabric, easy to clean and usable indoors or in shaded yard areas.
needs.rationale: Region is under an excessive heat warning — Thor should have an easy, immediate cooling surface to reduce heat stress during hot days in the PNW.

needs.family: Deshedding brush / rubber curry brush
needs.description: Undercoat rake or rubber curry brush suitable for short/medium coats to remove loose hair and reduce shedding. Durable, ergonomic handle for weekly use during fall shedding/allergy season.
needs.rationale: Calendar indicates fall shedding and allergy season — regular brushing reduces loose hair and environmental allergens in the home and reduces mats/skin issues.

needs.family: Anxiety wrap (thunder shirt-style pressure wrap)
needs.description: Adjustable pressure wrap sized for a 50 lb dog to provide calming compression during noisy events (leaf blowers, hunting season) and thunderstorms.
needs.rationale: Calendar shows leaf-blower and hunting seasons which can spike noise-related anxiety — a pressure wrap can reduce stress for noise-sensitive rescue dogs without medication.
evidence: pet_characteristic: about: Thor is a rescue puppy. Thor is very loving.

needs.family: Portable travel water bottle with bowl attachment
needs.description: Insulated, leakproof travel bottle that dispenses water into an attached bowl for walks and outings. 16–24 oz capacity recommended for short outings; dishwasher safe preferred.
needs.rationale: With heat alerts, Thor needs fresh water during walks/outdoor play; portable bottles avoid reliance on possibly contaminated outdoor sources.

needs.family: Treat pouch (hands-free, scent-proof)
needs.description: Wearable treat pouch with secure closure and clip to attach to belt or waistband, sized for frequent training treats and easy access during sessions.
needs.rationale: Frequent training is important for a rescue adolescent; a pouch increases training efficiency and keeps treats readily available without distracting the dog.

needs.family: Pet first-aid kit & tick removal tool
needs.description: Compact canine first-aid kit that includes bandages, antiseptic wipes, tweezers, and a tick removal tool. Durable case for outdoor/yard use.
needs.rationale: Large yard and hunting season increase chance of outdoor injuries or tick encounters; having non-medicated first-aid supplies on hand reduces risk while seeking veterinary care if needed.

needs.family: Paw balm and paw cleaning wipes
needs.description: Pet-safe paw balm for moisturizing and protecting pads, plus alcohol-free paw wipes for quick cleaning after outdoor play. Useful in hot or wet conditions.
needs.rationale: Heat and outdoor surfaces can irritate pads; paw care prevents cracking and removes allergens picked up outside during allergy season.

needs.family: Heavy-duty rubber chew toy (indestructible-style)
needs.description: Solid rubber treat-dispensing chew toy or ball designed for strong chewers; non-toxic, dense material that withstands heavy gnawing and can hold treats to encourage use.
needs.rationale: Thor has strong chew strength and is high energy — a durable chew toy satisfies chewing needs, reduces destructive chewing on household items and provides mental stimulation.

needs.family: Interactive puzzle feeder or slow-feed bowl
needs.description: Durable puzzle feeder or slow-feed bowl sized for a 50 lb dog to extend mealtime and provide mental stimulation; dishwasher-safe and non-slip base recommended.
needs.rationale: Puzzle feeders reduce gulping at mealtimes, increase mental engagement and help channel high energy into focused activity.

needs.family: Durable fetch balls / throw toys (non-toxic, tough)
needs.description: High-durability balls or chuck-it style balls made for strong mouths (non-fuzzy to avoid ingestion of fibers). Multiple sizes appropriate for medium-large mouths; floatable preferred for yard puddles or pool play.
needs.rationale: Thor is high-energy and needs vigorous physical exercise; durable fetch toys provide repeated high-intensity play sessions in a large yard.

needs.family: Heavy-duty tug rope / interactive tug toy
needs.description: Braided, reinforced tug toy designed for large, strong-jawed dogs — double-stitched handles and abrasion-resistant fibers for safe two-person play.
needs.rationale: Tug play builds bonding and expends energy; for a strong Pitbull mix this provides controlled outlet for prey-drive and strength while reinforcing impulse control exercises.

needs.family: Snuffle mat or scent training kit
needs.description: Snuffle mat or starter scent kit to hide kibble/treats for nose work; machine-washable materials and non-toxic construction recommended.
needs.rationale: Nose work provides mental stimulation and calm focus—valuable for a rescue dog to build confidence and reduce hyperactivity when outdoor play is limited (rain season).

needs.family: Plastic kiddie pool for dogs (durable, shallow)
needs.description: Shallow, sturdy dog-safe pool sized for medium-large dogs to cool off. Non-slip surface and easy drain; use in shaded area of yard.
needs.rationale: Heat warning makes safe cooling options important—supervised water play in a kiddie pool helps Thor regulate temperature and provides enrichment.

needs.family: Flirt pole (durable, replaceable head) for high-energy bursts
needs.description: Sturdy flirt pole with replaceable lure heads built for large dogs; telescoping handle optional for range. Encourages sprinting and quick directional changes in short intervals.
needs.rationale: Thor's high activity level benefits from short, intense exercise bouts—flirt poles provide focused, tiring play without needing long runs and are good for recall/impulse training.

needs.family: Durable treat-dispensing ball or toy
needs.description: Treat-dispensing ball or toy that releases kibble or small treats as it rolls; made from tough, non-toxic materials for strong chewers.
needs.rationale: Provides multi-purpose enrichment—physical activity and foraging behavior support—helpful on rainy days or after training sessions.

needs.family: Retrieve-and-hide toy set (multiple scents/textures)
needs.description: Set of hideable toys or scent-tagged items to encourage searching and retrieval in the yard—durable, washable materials appropriate for outdoor use.
needs.rationale: Encourages natural hunting/retrieval behaviors in a controlled way and provides mental engagement that complements physical exercise.
